editorial:
Imagine waking up in your own body but sharing it with an alien who refuses to follow orders. That is the wild setup here, as Melanie Stryder fights to stay herself while a parasitic soul called Wanda takes over. Instead of helping her race finish conquering Earth, Wanda starts caring about Melanie and the people she loves. The story mixes sci-fi action with a love triangle and a lot of emotional tension, so you get chase scenes, hidden human camps, and plenty of heart. It feels like a teen sci-fi romance with a bigger world behind it, and the desert hideout gives it a dusty, survival-focused vibe.

The acting is earnest, especially when Melanie and Wanda argue inside one body, and the action keeps things moving even when the romance slows down. Some scenes feel repetitive, and the pacing can drag in the middle, but the final act picks up with real stakes. If you enjoy young-adult sci-fi with emotional drama, this is a fun weekend pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture.
endingExplained: In the finale, Wanda helps the free humans and chooses to leave Melanie's body so Melanie can live with Jared. Wanda is placed into another body, a young woman who was dying, allowing her to survive and be with Ian. The humans and aliens reach an uneasy peace, and the story ends with hope that both species can share Earth instead of fighting forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves young-adult sci-fi with romance and survival drama.
